card.name: "Known" after patient or person nouns
card.fires_on: The word "known" right after a noun for a patient or person, as in "patients known to be hypersensitive". Also "is" before "suspected" in conditional clauses.

modes.label: Known after patient noun
modes.description: "known" follows patient, person or a condition noun and leads into "to be" or "as".

card.plain: It fires on the word "known" in phrases like "patients known to be allergic".
